title: add-downgrade-guard-schema-migrations-version-pinning-backup-restore-private-installer
author: Priya Malhotra
description: Motivation: Private Installer upgrades require stronger guards to avoid accidental downgrades and data loss during in-place upgrades. This PR adds downgrade-guard checks, explicit version pinning for helm/tf modules used by the private installer, an automated pre-upgrade backup/verify step, and safe schema migration helpers that can be run with a dry-run mode. The change is targeted at on-prem/VPC installs where operators may perform rolling upgrades and need clear rollback windows. What changed: 1) downgrade-guard: add server-side and installer validations that prevent applying a helm chart or operator image whose semver is lower than the currently deployed version unless a force flag is explicitly set with documented safety checks. 2) version pinning: pin terraform-module and helm-chart versions used by the private-installer to explicit sha/tag refs; introduce scripts to surface compatible runtime matrix. 3) backup/restore: add a pre-upgrade backup job and verification step (Postgres snapshot + objectstore manifest) and a restore smoke-test harness. 4) schema-migrations: wrap migrations in a migration-runner that supports dry-run/orphan-checks and records applied migration metadata to a migrations table with id, checksum, and applied_at to make rollbacks deterministic. 5) docs and release notes: add operator-facing upgrade checklist and example rollback playbook. Checklist: - [x] implement downgrade-guard server validation - [x] add helm and terraform pinning files + tooling - [x] backup/verify job and restore harness - [x] migration-runner with dry-run and idempotency checks - [x] unit + integration tests for migration runner - [x] docs and upgrade checklist - [x] QA verified on staging (3-node private-installer cluster) Testing & validation: ran full e2e on staging including upgrade from v1.8.2 -> v1.9.0, simulated interrupted migration to validate rollback path, and tested force-upgrade flow under explicit operator acknowledgement. CI: new integration matrix added to pipeline to exercise backup/restore and migration runner steps in ephemeral k8s clusters. Rollout plan: merge to main, publish new installer image tag, cut release and coordinate with Customer Success for early adopter installs, enable opt-in enforcement for 2 weeks before turning on strict block-by-default. Risk & mitigations: - Risk: migration runner missing a corner-case that leaves DB inconsistent. Mitigation: added checksum verification, staged migrations, and an explicit manual rollback-playbook. - Risk: restore times for very large DBs might exceed maintenance windows. Mitigation: documented expected windows and added a preflight estimate script. Related: ENG-7742 (migration runner), SUP-1198 (customer incident leading to this work).

release_notes:
- Private Installer: add downgrade guard to prevent accidental downgrades during upgrades
- Add pre-upgrade backup/verify job and restore smoke-test harness
- Introduce migration-runner with dry-run and checksum verification to make schema migrations safer
- Pin Helm charts and Terraform modules used by private-installer to explicit refs
- Add operator-facing upgrade checklist and rollback playbook
notes_for_oncall: If an operator reports failed migrations after an interrupted upgrade, run migration-runner --rollback --target=<last_known_good> and consult rollback-playbook.md. Use restore-smoke-test.sh to validate restored DB before bringing services back online. Contact migrations@redwood.com for emergency assistance.
